metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 22 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need air temperature data at 2m height. Best source is ERA5-Land which provides hourly data at ~9km resolution. Need to filter for Boston area and date range Jan 29-Feb 5, 2019. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for ERA5 temperature data. This is model data, not optical imagery. 3. Logic: Calculate daily maximum temperatures for each day in the range, then find the difference between highest and lowest daily max temperatures. Check if this difference is ≥22°C. Let me break this down: - Use ERA5-Land hourly data for temperature_2m - Filter to Boston area (approx coordinates: 42.36°N, -71.06°W) - Calculate daily maximum temperatures - Find the range (max - min) of daily maximum temperatures - Check if range ≥ 22°C Need to handle potential data issues: - Check if collection has data - Check if we get valid temperature values - Validate the temperature range makes sense (not extreme values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.0589, 42.3601]); const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-06'; // Exclusive end date to include Feb 5 // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land for temperature at 2m const tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(boston) .select('temperature_2m'); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No temperature data found for the specified period."); print("C1"); return; } print(`ERA5-Land images found: ${collectionSize}`); // 3. Calculate daily maximum temperatures // Group by day and calculate max temperature for each day const dailyMax = tempCollection .map(function(image) { const date = image.date(); const day = date.format('YYYY-MM-dd'); return image.set('date', day); }) .reduceColumns({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().group(0, 'date'), selectors: ['temperature_2m', 'date'] }); const dailyMaxValues = dailyMax.get('groups').getInfo(); if (!dailyMaxValues || dailyMaxValues.length === 0) { print("No daily maximum temperatures calculated."); print("C3"); return; } // Extract temperature values and convert from Kelvin to Celsius const tempsCelsius = dailyMaxValues.map(group => { const tempK = group.max; return tempK - 273.15; // Convert Kelvin to Celsius }); print(`Daily max temperatures (°C): ${tempsCelsius.map(t => t.toFixed(1)).join(', ')}`); print(`Days with data: ${tempsCelsius.length}`); // Check if we have valid temperature data if (tempsCelsius.length === 0) { print("No valid temperature data after processing."); print("C2"); return; } // Validate temperature range (sanity check) const validTemps = tempsCelsius.filter(temp => temp > -50 && temp < 50); if (validTemps.length !== tempsCelsius.length) { print("Invalid temperature values detected."); print("C3"); return; } // 4. Calculate temperature range const maxTemp = Math.max(...tempsCelsius); const minTemp = Math.min(...tempsCelsius); const tempRange = maxTemp - minTemp; print(`Max daily temp: ${maxTemp.toFixed(1)}°C`); print(`Min daily temp: ${minTemp.toFixed(1)}°C`); print(`Temperature range: ${tempRange.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Final answer if (tempRange >= 22) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
